summary: Serializable, Frictionless-aligned type metadata and schema I/O: TableSchema/FieldDefinition/FieldConstraints, DataPackage/DataResource/TableDialect, Frictionless v2 descriptor codec with LocationPolicy-aware reference resolution, extraction from dataframes/dataclasses/Pydantic, conversion to native schemas via adapter registry, and schema comparison/validation.
key_classes: TableSchema — frozen table declaration (fields, keys, fields_match, contract) with from_simple_dict/from_frictionless/to_frictionless/to_contract
FieldDefinition — shared field declaration used by schemas and contracts
DataPackage / DataResource / TableDialect — Pydantic models for Frictionless packages with to_descriptor/from_descriptor/from_path/write/to_relation_dag
UniversalType — Frictionless boundary type enum mapped to canonical dtypes
DescriptorContext / DescriptorResolver — base URI context and controlled reference resolvers
NativeSchemaAdapter / SchemaCodec — Protocols for native schema adapters and interchange codecs
PolarsSchemaAdapter / ArrowSchemaAdapter / PandasSchemaAdapter / IbisSchemaAdapter / NarwhalsSchemaAdapter — native schema adapters
SourceShape — schema-only structural evidence from a native source
DescriptorError and TypeSpecError hierarchies — typed descriptor and semantics errors
key_functions: decode_package_descriptor / decode_package_json / decode_package_path / encode_package_descriptor — v2 codec
extract_from_dataframe/dataclass/pydantic — build a TableSchema from a source
to_polars_schema / to_arrow_schema / to_ibis_schema / to_pandas_dtypes — native schema converters
validate_match / assert_match — compare schema vs data
declaration_fingerprint(value) — stable hash of frozen declarations
extension_points: NativeSchemaAdapter and SchemaCodec Protocols resolved via adapter_registry
CustomTypeRegistry / TypeConverter for custom semantic types
lifecycle_notes: 381 series (cdee565d, 22931331, 005897de, a1bae99f, 54ddc663): descriptor references and ResourceRef obey LocationPolicy with one descriptor resolver.
838a285b: shared schema declarations and adapter ownership refactor; c1e8da53 canonical dtype schema declarations (333, #399).
Frictionless v2 codec; v1 markers are rejected (frictionless_invariants).
documentation_hooks: Frictionless Table Schema and DataPackage read/write
Extracting schemas from dataframes, dataclasses and Pydantic
risks: Lossless raw Frictionless storage means conversion to TypeSpec is lazy; behaviour differs between raw descriptor and resolved schema.
Descriptor reference resolution is security sensitive (policy confinement, scheme rejection); regressions were fixed across several 381 commits.
Circular package dependencies with conform, validation, datacontracts and relations.dag, handled via lazy imports.

evidence.detail: __all__ re-exports spec, extraction, converters, datapackage, descriptor context
